# Phase Two — Gevurah Critique and Improvements

The Awtsmoos makes every instant new; Awtsmoos.com must therefore remove old selector wars rather than gild them blue.
This pass attacks the first brainstorm with evidence from the live route graph.

## Evidence that changes the plan

- The post route directly loads `critical-shell.css`, `live-template.css`, and `mobile-reading.css` in addition to `main.css`.
- `main.css` imports several historical owner generations at once.
- `scroll-root.css`, `settings-shell.css`, `settings-groups.css`, `settings-controls.css`, and `actions.css` contain extensive `!important` use.
- `critical-shell.css` and `mobile-reading.css` both own floating-control placement.
- Auto-scroll writes only to the document/window, while reader virtualization can resolve an inner `.scroll-view-wrapper`.
- Auto-scroll JS also sets `scroll-behavior` with priority `important`.
- Community loading is intentionally fail-closed through the `/comment-tree` transport and must be runtime verified rather than visually concealed.
- The standalone social system is already root-scoped and modular, making it a good style vocabulary rather than a subsystem to destroy.

## Twenty-five concrete improvements over phase one

1. Give the reader exactly one scroll-root contract shared by motion and measurement.
2. Prefer a scrollable `.scroll-view-wrapper` only when it can actually move; otherwise use the document root.
3. Remove JS priority arguments entirely; smooth-scroll suppression must use ordinary inline properties.
4. Rewrite direct-loaded `critical-shell.css` as structural first-paint CSS with no duplicated mobile placement rules.
5. Rewrite `scroll-root.css` without `!important`, relying on scoped ownership and source order.
6. Stop loading two owners for the same floating-control geometry.
7. Split the oversized `actions.css` into small import children and leave the legacy path as an import vessel.
8. Put floating rail geometry, state colors, and interaction states in separate CSS modules.
9. Split settings presentation into glass shell, groups, controls, flow, and responsive ownership with no declaration escalation.
10. Use `:focus-visible` rather than removing outlines.
11. Keep `:hover` enhancements behind hover-capable media queries.
12. Give `:active` a physically distinct press state on every actionable family.
13. Add explicit disabled and `aria-disabled` states.
14. Add `prefers-reduced-motion` fallbacks without `!important`.
15. Reserve safe-area bottom space so the river orb cannot cover reading content.
16. Make the Scribe's Lens a bounded glass sheet with internal scrolling and clear grouped hierarchy.
17. Make the primary auto-scroll action visually primary only when it is actionable; state color must distinguish start, pause, and stop.
18. Keep WPM/pace copy synchronized from existing state rather than duplicating behavior in CSS.
19. Convert community retry presentation into the same glass language without mutating its honest error semantics.
20. Verify `/comment-tree` transport independently before touching its URL contract.
21. Intensify social tokens with cyan/violet/gold depth while preserving contrast.
22. Add ambient social light and scan motion that disables cleanly under reduced-motion preference.
23. Give social cards focus-within and hover elevation instead of hover-only beauty.
24. Keep all social selectors beneath `.awtsmoos-social-root` so the enterprise layer cannot leak into the reader.
25. Add automated checks for `!important`, JS syntax, auto-scroll inner-root movement, and existing social contracts before browser verification.

## Risk graph

`post HTML` -> `main.css` -> historical imports -> selector collision -> mobile overlap.
`auto-scroll toggle` -> controller -> motion -> document helper -> wrong root -> visible state without movement.
`community tab` -> fetching -> tree transport -> API failure -> honest retry state.
`social demo/app` -> local root -> token/layout/feed modules -> safe candidate for visual intensification.

## Revised file strategy

Do not append a giant override stylesheet. Rewrite current owners or convert them into small import vessels. Introduce only small focused modules. Preserve public selectors and JS contracts so behavior remains stable while ownership becomes singular.

## REMAINING_WORK

- Write final phase-three execution map with exact source files.
- Implement shared auto-scroll root resolver and document adapter.
- Rewrite active reader structural CSS owners without `!important`.
- Split action rail into focused modules.
- Rewrite settings owner modules without `!important` and improve hierarchy.
- Intensify social tokens/base/layout/feed without leaking selectors.
- Add targeted tests/quality checks.
- Runtime verify community transport.
- Browser verify post controls/settings/community and social demo at mobile + desktop widths.
- Re-read all touched files and resolve DELTA.

## NEXT_ACTION

Freeze the exact touched-file list and verification gates, then begin full-file writes only.
